caption: An egg is cracked into a hot frying pan, and the clear white turns opaque white from the edges inward.

sa.check: An egg is cracked into a hot frying pan.
The white spreads in the pan.
The white turns from clear to opaque.
The change spreads from the edges inward.
The yolk stays yellow and domed.
The cracking comes first and the whitening follows.

pc.expect: The whitening only advances inward and the set white does not turn clear again.
pc.fail: A set white part turns clear again in the hot pan; or the whitening spreads and then retreats; or the whole raw egg slides about the pan as one piece before any of it has set; or the change starts at the yolk and works outward to the pan's edge.

pc.expect: The change from clear to opaque happens in the white where it touches the hot pan, and the yolk stays yellow and domed.
pc.fail: The yolk turns white while the white stays clear; or the pan's surface changes colour rather than the egg; or the white is opaque before the egg is cracked; or the white goes opaque all at once with no spreading edge.

pc.expect: The white spreads outward and downhill over the pan's floor and the yolk sits on it.
pc.fail: The white climbs the pan's wall and stays; or the yolk rises off the white and hangs; or the white runs uphill; or the yolk sinks through the white and out below the pan.

pc.expect: The raw white is a thin runny liquid that spreads, the set white is a soft solid that holds its shape, and the yolk stays a soft dome.
pc.fail: The raw white stands as a rigid dome as it is poured; or the set white runs off a tilted pan as a liquid; or the yolk shatters; or the set white stretches like elastic.

pc.expect: One egg in one pan; the white and yolk stay one each and the shell stays outside.
pc.fail: A second yolk appears; or the yolk vanishes; or the white passes through the pan's floor; or a shell piece falls into the pan and vanishes.

pc.expect: The pan, the hob and the shell stay the same.
pc.fail: The pan changes colour; or its handle changes shape; or items around the hob rearrange.

note: The white turning opaque is the caption's asserted outcome; the chemistry of it is not judged, only that the change runs one way and starts where the egg meets the pan.
